Synopsis:
    UK PM Andy Burnham reaffirmed his position that a border poll on Irish unification will not occur without demonstrated majority public support in Northern Ireland. The statement was issued in response to Trump's remarks expressing support for a united Ireland following his meeting with Irish PM Micheal Martin in Dublin. No policy shift is signaled — Burnham's stance is explicitly unchanged.
